column1: # REST requests with bad input or missing auth (QA-owned). Spec: docs/protocol.md sections 3 and 14.
# Columns: id, method, path, auth, body, status, code, note.
# auth:   NONE | VALID (fresh account) | GARBAGE ('Bearer x') | BASIC ('Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz') | EMPTY ('Bearer ') |
#         REVOKED (token revoked by a transfer) | DELETED (account deleted) | ADMIN_WITH_USER_TOKEN (account token on /admin).
# status: expected HTTP status; alternatives with '|'. code: ErrorResponse.code ('-' = no JSON body checked).
# {self} and {other} in a path are replaced by the caller's and another account's player id.
# Format: UTF-8, tab-separated, '#' starts a comment line, first non-comment line is the header.
# Escapes in text columns (decoded by the QA loaders, QaCorpus.kt):
#   \R[N:TEXT] repeats TEXT N times (inside TEXT write \] for ']').
# Invisible, control, bidi and confusable characters are ALWAYS written as escapes so a reviewer can see them;
# QaCorporaWellFormedTest fails if a raw invisible/control/bidi character appears in this file.
